explanation: The response recognizes only the broad themes of high-entropy alloys, HER/HOR, activity, and durability. It neither names the specific Pd@PtRuFeCoNi core–shell catalyst nor reconstructs its nanoscale structure, synthesis, operating conditions, mechanism, controls, or measured performance.
